blocks.text: They live in a huge and beautiful homey house. It is located at the bottom of a big mountain, away from the noisy big city. It is surrounded by a big garden with colorful flowers, green plants, bushes, palm trees and fruit trees. It also has a nice swimming pool. There are some cozy apartments in the back part and a big kiosko to make parties. There is also a small and cute chapel surrounded by beautiful flowers. It has some swings, and bars for the children. You can lay down on the grass and just close your eyes and let yourself go. You can listen to the birds, whistling, feel the air going by and enjoy the beauty of nature.
Answer the questions according to the paragraph.

blocks.text: There are four Dobermans. They take care of the house at night. There are also two puppies that live in the house. Besides the huge garden, the house has two floors. On the first floor, you can find the cleaning room, the kitchen, the dining room, the living room, the room service, a big garage, a bathroom and a hall. On the second floor there are four bedrooms, an office, a TV room, three bathrooms and a hall.
